Jaipur's RIICO industrial zones, infrastructure expansion, and fast-growing real-estate corridor generate steady demand for porta cabins — from security guard rooms at factory gates to multi-room contractor offices at construction sites. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and despatches them to Jaipur in 3 to 5 days. For buyers in Rajasthan, our cabins are specified with heat-management options that address Jaipur's extreme summer conditions — not an afterthought, but a core part of the build. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your requirement.

Why SAMAN for Porta Cabins in Jaipur

Jaipur buyers searching online typically land on IndiaMART and TradeIndia listing pages — marketplace aggregators that show mixed suppliers without specifying frame grade, panel thickness, or any heat-management detail. For Rajasthan's climate, those gaps matter more than anywhere else in North India.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. When you call us, you are talking to the team that builds the cabin and understands what Jaipur's summer does to a poorly specified structure:

  • Unventilated PUF panels lose insulation efficiency above 45°C
  • Bare MS frames without zinc-phosphate primer rust faster in the dust-and-occasional-moisture cycle of Rajasthan's climate
  • A cabin without a proper drainage-slope roof becomes a water trap during Jaipur's short but intense monsoon in July–August

We specify for these conditions by default. Turbo ventilators, false ceilings, and AC provisions are standard options we recommend — not add-ons we offer only if you ask.

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647) certifications, along with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Transit: 3–5 days from Greater Noida to Jaipur. Return policy: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Jaipur's Industrial Zones and Porta Cabin Demand

Jaipur's industrial and construction activity is clustered in zones that each generate specific types of porta cabin demand:

RIICO Sitapura Industrial Area (PIN 302022): Jaipur's largest and most active RIICO zone. Automotive components, gems and jewellery processing, and garment manufacturing dominate. Factory gate security cabins and portable supervisor offices are the most common requirement. The zone's high density of mid-size manufacturing units means recurring orders — a plant adds a cabin, relocates, or replaces an older unit.

RIICO Mansarovar Industrial Area (PIN 302020): Light engineering, plastics, and packaging units. Security posts at plot entries and portable tool stores are the typical use here. Compact single-room and double-room cabins are the standard format.

RIICO Vishwakarma Industrial Area (PIN 302013): Engineering workshops and auto-repair ancillary units near Jaipur's older industrial belt. Security cabins and small portable offices for owner-managers working on site.

Jaipur Metro Rail Phase 2: Active construction on the East-West corridor generates contractor office demand at multiple sites simultaneously. Metro rail construction is one of the highest-volume single-project sources of porta cabin orders in any Indian city.

Real-Estate Corridors — Ajmer Road, Tonk Road, Sikar Road: Rapid residential development along Jaipur's major approach roads creates demand for portable sales offices at project launch sites and on-site management cabins throughout the construction phase.

NH-48 (Jaipur–Delhi) Corridor: Road expansion and infrastructure projects along the Delhi–Jaipur expressway stretch require portable site offices at regular intervals — a consistent order type for any manufacturer with a Greater Noida despatch point.

SAMAN's Greater Noida factory is 270 km from Jaipur via NH-48 — the shortest factory-to-city route of any certified manufacturer serving Jaipur from outside Rajasthan. It is the same expressway that carries our Delhi NCR porta cabin supply.

Porta Cabin Specifications — Built for Rajasthan's Climate

Jaipur's climate is one of the most demanding in North India for prefab structures: extreme summer heat (45°C+), dry dusty winds in May–June, a short but heavy monsoon in July–August, and cold winters with near-freezing nights. Every SAMAN cabin despatched to Jaipur is specified with these conditions in mind.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded joints, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated in RAL colour of your choice. The primer coat is critical for Jaipur — fine dust particles and occasional pre-monsoon moisture create a mild abrasive-corrosive cycle on bare or poorly primed metal surfaces.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels as standard. For cabins that will face direct western or southern sun exposure in Sitapura or Mansarovar, we recommend an additional reflective roof coating or a colour-coated GI outer skin in a light colour (white, cream, or light grey) to reduce solar heat gain.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling. Turbo ventilators strongly recommended on all Jaipur orders — they are one of the most cost-effective heat-management additions for an open industrial-site cabin.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate. In dusty Jaipur environments, chequered plate is preferred for site offices and stores — easier to clean.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows. Fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8 ft × 10 ft · 10 ft × 12 ft · 10 ft × 20 ft · 10 ft × 30 ft · 10 ft × 40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room modular block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Jaipur

Porta cabins from SAMAN are used across Jaipur for:

  • RIICO factory gate security: Single-room guard cabins at Sitapura, Mansarovar, and Vishwakarma plot entries — the highest recurring demand type from Jaipur's manufacturing sector.
  • Contractor site offices: Multi-room project offices at Jaipur Metro Phase 2 sites, Ajmer Road and Tonk Road residential project sites, and NH-48 corridor infrastructure works.
  • Labour accommodation: Worker colony blocks for outstation construction labour at large project sites in Jaipur's expansion zones — Jagatpura, Pratap Nagar, and Sanganer.
  • Real-estate sales offices: Portable cabin sales offices at project launches on Sikar Road, Ajmer Road, and the Jaipur-Agra expressway corridor.
  • Temporary material stores: Lockable portable stores for tools and construction materials at project yards — widely used on Jaipur's fast-moving residential development sites.

Customisation Options

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built to your specification:

  • Custom room dimensions and multi-room modular layouts
  • Colour choice from standard RAL palette — light colours (white, cream, off-white) recommended for Jaipur's direct sun
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + dedicated power point) — practically essential for any working office in Jaipur between April and July
  • Turbo ventilator — strongly recommended on all Jaipur orders
  • Internal false ceiling for thermal comfort
  • Internal partition walls
  • Extra door or window units
  • Plumbing provision for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where structural load calculations allow

Tell us your site location, sun exposure, required size, and use case. We confirm specifications and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Jaipur

The price of a porta cabin in Jaipur depends on:

  1. Size: 8×10 ft single-room at the entry end; 10×40 ft four-room block at the upper end.
  2. Panel type: PUF sandwich panel vs cement-board. For most Jaipur dry-climate sites, PUF with a light-colour outer skin is sufficient.
  3. Fit-out level: Structural shell vs fully fitted with electrical, flooring, painting, and AC provision.
  4. Heat-management additions: Turbo ventilator, false ceiling, AC provision — practical necessities for Jaipur that should be budgeted from day one, not added as a surprise later.
  5. Quantity: Orders for 5 or more units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Jaipur for your specific size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Jaipur

We despatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via NH-48 on flatbed trucks. At 270 km, Jaipur is one of our shortest North-region delivery routes. Standard transit: 3–5 days.

On delivery, the cabin is placed on your pre-cast RCC plinth. Anchor bolts are secured, panels confirmed, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready to use within hours. A multi-room block takes approximately one day on site.

Delivery charge: ₹3,000 standard. Multiple cabins in one truck — confirm consolidated rate at order stage.

We do not have a Jaipur showroom or warehouse. Every cabin is manufactured to order at Greater Noida and delivered factory-direct to your RIICO plot or construction site. We serve other North-India cities from the same factory — see our porta cabin in Kanpur and porta cabin in Chandigarh pages.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Jaipur

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to RIICO Sitapura and Mansarovar?

Yes. We deliver to all RIICO zones in Jaipur — Sitapura, Mansarovar, Vishwakarma, and Bindayaka — and to construction sites anywhere in Jaipur district. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

How does a porta cabin perform in Jaipur's 45°C+ summer heat?

With the right specification, well. We recommend three additions for all Jaipur orders: a turbo ventilator, an internal false ceiling, and an AC provision (wall-sleeve + power point). A light RAL colour (white or cream) on the outer skin reduces solar heat gain significantly compared to dark colours. A cabin with these additions performs comfortably as a working office even in peak Rajasthan summer. Without them, a bare cabin in direct sun becomes unusable by mid-morning in May.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Jaipur?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and heat-management additions. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built around your specific site and requirement. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

How does SAMAN's cabin handle Jaipur's dust and the brief monsoon season?

The MS frame is zinc-phosphate primed before powder coating — this gives it resistance to the dust-and-moisture abrasion cycle common in Rajasthan. Panel joints are factory-sealed before despatch, not site-sealed after arrival. The GI roof has a controlled drainage slope so the July–August monsoon rain runs off cleanly without pooling.

Can I get a porta cabin for a real-estate sales office launch in Jaipur?

Yes. A 10×12 ft or 10×20 ft porta cabin makes an effective temporary sales office — easy to brand, quick to install, and fully removable when the project is done. We can add a canopy, glass-front door, and AC provision to match the presentation standard that Jaipur's real-estate market expects.

Get a Quote for Your Porta Cabin in Jaipur

For a porta cabin in Jaipur delivered to your RIICO zone, project site, or construction location, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937. Send an enquiry using the contact form and we will respond with specifications built for Rajasthan's conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation.

Explore our custom porta cabin configurations for the complete product range — sizes, panel options, and heat-management specs.
